shell_commands:
/usr/bin/zsh -lc "if [ -f ../round-brief.md ]; then sed -n '1,260p' ../round-brief.md; fi
sed -n '1,280p' .lore/dod.md
printf '\\n--- test command metadata ---\\n'
sed -n '1,240p' .lore/test-commands.yml
printf '\\n--- git status ---\\n'
git status --short --branch"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "command -v lore-query-trace || true
rg -n \"called with session and error when stream fails|error still propagates after onError hook|error path calls onError then afterSession|onError\" src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md CHANGELOG.md src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts
sed -n '1,140p' src/orchestration/onErrorNonError.acceptance.test.ts
sed -n '1,180p' specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md
sed -n '1,260p' src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "npx prettier --write specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md .lore/dod.md
nl -ba specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md | sed -n '14,22p'
nl -ba src/orchestration/onErrorNonError.acceptance.test.ts | sed -n '50,70p'
git diff --check
git diff -- specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md .lore/dod.md
git status --short"
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git add .lore/dod.md specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md && git commit -m "Fix onError acceptance spec links" && git push origin HEAD'
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git fetch origin main && git merge origin/main && git push origin HEAD && git status --short --branch'
